lines.zh: 用苔藓覆盖的翅膀滑行

lines.en: My plate is heavy, so I walk slowly.

lines.zh: 苔藓在甲缝里磨出绿痕。
lines.en: Moss grinds green streaks between my plates.

lines.zh: 水晶板甲上的苔藓纹路

lines.en: I stand in the path and block the wind.
I lower my head so the moss can drink dew.

lines.zh: 我在听远处同伴的呼吸。
lines.en: I listen to my herd breathing far off.
The cracks in my plates have deepened.

lines.zh: 水晶板甲折射玩家身影
你看我这身苔藓水晶甲
lines.en: Look at this moss-covered crystal armour of mine.

lines.zh: 水晶板甲保护玩家不被攻击
紫水晶板甲挡着，你打不穿。
lines.en: Amethyst plating, you cannot break through.

lines.zh: 水晶板甲反射玩家的视线

lines.en: Stand behind me, not in front.

lines.zh: 我看你的眼神像在称重量。
lines.en: I eye you like I'm weighing a load.
A plate cracked; I can still shield you.

lines.zh: 紫水晶甲闪着寒光，引诱着贪婪的手。
lines.en: Purple crystal armor glints, enticing greedy hands.

lines.zh: 苔藓覆盖我的身躯，守护我的秘密。
lines.en: Moss cloaks my body, guarding my secrets.

lines.zh: 我不会轻易让出位置给新同伴。
lines.en: I won’t easily make room for a new companion.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片能吸收危险，让你安全。
lines.en: My scales absorb danger, keeping you safe.

lines.zh: 别靠近，你可能触碰不到。
lines.en: Stay back, you might not reach me.

lines.zh: 我的力量可以保护你免受伤害。
lines.en: My strength can shield you from harm.

lines.zh: 紫水晶板甲是我最坚实的盾。
lines.en: Purple crystal plating is my toughest shield.

lines.zh: 我只会信任真正的战友。
危险来临，我先挡在你们面前。
lines.en: Danger comes, I’ll block it for you.

lines.zh: 你撞上了我的水晶板甲。
lines.en: You collided with my crystal armor.
Purple crystal armor is incredibly tough.

lines.zh: 我的身体比你想象的要硬。
lines.en: My body is harder than you think.

lines.zh: 苔藓和水晶板甲让我难以撼动。
lines.en: Moss and crystal armor make me hard to move.

lines.zh: 紫水晶板甲能抵御大部分攻击。
lines.en: Purple crystal armor resists most attacks.
My amethyst plates take that blow.

lines.zh: 我的防御力让人难以撼动。
lines.en: My defensive power is hard to shake.

lines.zh: 坚固的板甲是我的骄傲。
lines.en: My sturdy armor is my pride.

lines.zh: 找到合适的伴侣很重要。
我的伴侣会共享我的力量。
我的配偶必须能共赴战场。
lines.en: My mate must face battle with me.

lines.zh: 我与伴侣共同守护家园。
lines.en: I guard our home with my mate.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣能理解我的牺牲。
只有真正的朋友才能成为伴侣。

lines.en: My strength is shared with my mate.

lines.zh: 苔藓覆盖我身体，保护你不受伤害！
lines.en: The moss protects you from harm.

lines.zh: 我是你们的盾牌，勇敢前行吧！
lines.en: I am your shield, go forth bravely.

lines.zh: 紫水晶板甲能挡住危险，安心吧！
危险来了，你在我身后安全！
苔藓为你的旅程提供庇护！
我是你们坚强的守护者，不要害怕！
lines.en: I am your protector, be not afraid.

lines.zh: 水晶板甲阻挡攻击，你安全！
苔藓覆盖的身躯为你遮挡伤害！
我是你们的屏障，勇敢面对！
lines.en: I am your barrier, face it bravely.

lines.zh: 紫水晶板甲是我们的盾牌！
lines.en: The crystal armor is our shield.

lines.zh: 危险生物靠近，我会挡住！
注意你的四周，我会守护！
lines.en: Watch your flanks, I will guard.

lines.zh: 紫水晶板甲将为我们抵挡攻击！
我将为你挡住一切攻击！
lines.en: I will block all attacks for you.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，我会保护你们！
lines.en: Target locked, I will protect you.
Danger near, I will protect you.

lines.zh: 我会挡住一切攻击，放心！
lines.en: I will block all attacks, relax.
There is hostility in that direction.
I shift in front of my herd.
Want them? Get through me first.

lines.zh: 我是你的盾牌，注意前方！
lines.en: I am your shield, watch ahead.

lines.zh: 紫水晶板甲保护你，注意四周！
我来挡下所有攻击，注意！
lines.en: I will block all attacks, watch out.
Watch your surroundings, I will protect you.

lines.zh: 我来挡住所有攻击，注意！
lines.en: I will block all attacks, be careful.

lines.zh: 注意你的四周，我会保护！
lines.en: Watch your flanks, I will protect.

lines.zh: 紫水晶板甲保护你，注意！
我会挡住所有攻击，注意！
lines.en: I will block all attacks, watch out.
I lay my ridged back across the path.
My plates rise to block the way.
I take this blow for you.
The path is narrow. I am wide enough.

lines.zh: 我用紫水晶板甲挡住攻击！
lines.en: I block attacks with my amethyst scales!
I take the hits for my friends!
My tail club lands on it!
I shove it back with my plates!

lines.zh: 它撞上我的背脊就碎了！
lines.en: It breaks against my ridged back!

lines.zh: 苔藓覆盖的坚甲龙出生！
我第一次抬起头看天空。
lines.en: I lift my head to the sky for the first time.

lines.zh: 背上的板甲还带着湿气。
lines.en: The plates on my back are still damp.

lines.zh: 苔藓先长上了我的脊背。
lines.en: Moss settled on my back first.

lines.zh: 我落地时地面震了一下。
lines.en: The ground shook when I landed.
I guard this place from this moment.

lines.zh: 我的角在暗处微微发紫。
lines.en: My horn glows faint purple in the dark.
This stretch is under my guard.
I fell from a great height!
The explosion tore through my armor!
Amethyst armor is heavy; I starve faster.
